ch1_intro_1.speaker: Elias
ch1_intro_1.text: Sector 7 Slums. A bit rot graveyard. Perfect place to hide a Golden Data Cube.

ch1_intro_2.speaker: Cipher Client
ch1_intro_2.text: [RADIO]: Remember, Elias. The Cube contains sensitive Archive logs. Do not let the Sweepers find it.

ch1_intro_3.speaker: Elias
ch1_intro_3.text: Just have my UX Index payout ready. I'm moving in.

ch2_silence_hour_1.speaker: Vesper
ch2_silence_hour_1.text: Hold it, Mercenary. You're making too much noise in the low-poly zone.

ch2_silence_hour_2.speaker: Elias
ch2_silence_hour_2.text: An Eroded? What are you doing out here? The Glitch Fauna are restless.

ch2_silence_hour_3.speaker: Vesper
ch2_silence_hour_3.text: Looking for the same thing you are. But we have a bigger problem. The Archive is routing power to Substation 07.

ch5_foreign_ozone_1.speaker: Elias
ch5_foreign_ozone_1.text: I smell ozone... and burning copper. The Substation is active.

ch5_foreign_ozone_2.speaker: Vesper
ch5_foreign_ozone_2.text: It's an Overclocked Maintenance Mech. They're trying to seal the blast doors! We have to destroy it!

ch5_foreign_ozone_3.speaker: Elias
ch5_foreign_ozone_3.text: Time to earn my pay. Let's scrap this rust bucket.
